title: Asymptotics of Weighted Bergman Polynomials under Finite Regularity
summary: We study strong asymptotics of planar orthogonal polynomials with respect to fixed weighted area measures on Jordan domains. The aim is to understand how the regularity of the domain and the weight enter the large-degree asymptotic behavior of these polynomials. For domains with real-analytic boundaries, Suetin established leading-order asymptotics for Hölder continuous weights, while Hedenmalm--Wennman obtained a full asymptotic expansion for real-analytic weights.
